metadata.title: Next.js Boilerplate
metadata.description: Production-ready Next.js starter with REST, JWT auth, i18n, Biome, and lightweight animations.

home.title: Build fast, secure, multilingual apps.
home.subtitle: Modern Next.js boilerplate with REST APIs, JWT-ready auth, i18n, Biome, secure defaults, and lightweight UI animations.
home.authDescription: HTTP-only token cookies, refresh flow hooks, server REST client, and client auth state are ready to connect to any backend.
home.restDescription: Typed fetch wrapper with timeout, error normalization, locale headers, cache controls, and bearer token support.
home.i18nDescription: Locale routing, aligned translations, metadata, and language switcher for English, Uzbek, and Russian.
home.securityDescription: Latest packages, strict TypeScript, Biome checks, secure headers, no GraphQL/Apollo surface, and safe defaults.
home.performanceDescription: Server components, small client islands, strict env validation, request timeouts, and package import optimization.
home.healthCardDescription: Use this route as deployment smoke test.
home.animationDescription: Motion-powered micro-interactions for polished UI with small client-side overhead.
